why: up_send_smp_call is implemented only in arch/arm64 (arm64_gicv3.c), CONFIG_SMP_CALL is gated under 'if SMP' (sim defconfig has no CONFIG_SMP), and the PR body/review comment explicitly test on qemu-armv8a:nsh_smp; the smp_call ostest test cannot compile/link/run on sim:nsh.
reason: Kernel PR 10934 adds a genuine SMP function-call feature (sched/sched/sched_smp.c with nxsched_smp_call/nxsched_smp_call_single/nxsched_smp_call_handler, Kconfig CONFIG_SMP_CALL, and arch/arm64 up_send_smp_call), and apps PR 2137 adds the matching ostest regression test smp_call_test, registered in ostest_main.c/ostest.h/Makefile/CMakeLists.txt under CONFIG_SMP_CALL. The test calls nxsched_smp_call_single/nxsched_smp_call (absent from the base kernel, so it fails to compile against the old kernel and passes on the fixed one), but it cannot run on sim:nsh: CONFIG_SMP_CALL lives inside the 'if SMP' block of sched/Kconfig and sim has no CONFIG_SMP, and the per-architecture hook up_send_smp_call is implemented only in arch/arm64/src/common/arm64_gicv3.c (no arch/sim or generic implementation). The PR itself targets qemu-armv8a:nsh_smp. The pair is sound but only runnable on a QEMU board.
